description: Use for statutory values of this year: IKE and IKZE limits, PIT and minimum wage, tax on lottery, betting and contest winnings, PCC tax on a private loan or a sale of used goods, the cost of renouncing or disclaiming an inheritance. For next year, use get_next_year_limits (property tax: get_property_tax_next_year). Statutory values for the current year: IKE and IKZE contribution limits, PIT thresholds and rates, tax-free amount, capital gains tax, rental flat-rate tax, minimum wage and other limits, company social benefits fund (ZFŚS) allowance per employee with transfer deadlines, and the GUS life expectancy table (months at ages 55-75, current and previous edition) that ZUS uses to compute pensions; voluntary NFZ health insurance: minimum monthly contribution for the current quarter and a finwire prediction for the next quarter (9% of the GUS average enterprise-sector wage of the previous quarter) and the one-off surcharge for a gap in insurance; business limits in euro (small VAT, PIT and CIT taxpayer, flat-rate tax eligibility, de minimis one-off depreciation, full accounting threshold) in PLN for the previous, current and next year at the NBP rate from the law, fiscal penal code fines and thresholds, company car private use amounts; taxes on private transactions: tax on winnings and prizes (10%, exemption thresholds per game or contest type), civil law transactions tax PCC on private loans, sales of movables and property rights (rates, exemptions, PCC-3 deadline) and maximum costs of renouncing a future inheritance versus disclaiming an inheritance; topic "local-tax" gives the upper limits of local property tax rates. Company tax regimes (CIT, Estonian CIT, IP Box) and business rules: get_business_guide.
